page.title: Minimalist product video template in Swiss style, free
page.description: A Swiss-style launch video: a strict grid, one red accent, sharp type and hard wipes. Describe your product and edit everything. Free, in your browser.
page.blurb: White space, a visible grid and one red accent. Type rises on the grid, numbers sit in their column, and every cut is a clean wipe. It reads as confident and considered, which is what a developer tool should say about itself.
